name: Account 35
definition: Business relationship between two entities; one entity is the account owner, the other entity is the account servicer.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification for the account between the account owner and the account servicer.

AccountServicer.name: Account Servicer
AccountServicer.definition: Institution servicing the account and assigning the account identifier to the account owner.
